facts.fact: 丈夫 Dorian 为升职要去外地三日。
Dorian 每日比她早起读报，早餐是石榴籽配压榨咖啡。
facts.anchor: a plate of pomegranate seeds beside a pressed coffee every morning

facts.fact: 婚后拮据时 Dorian 用仅有的钱买了浅蓝丝巾，她至今最珍爱。
facts.anchor: the light blue silk he’d bought for me on our wedding day

facts.fact: 她昨夜已用 Otherside 之力让那个天文工程师职位归他。
facts.anchor: that position had been his the minute my hand dipped through to the Otherside last night

facts.fact: 城市 Astraea 之名源自 astēr（星），市民按星辰而活。
facts.anchor: The name Astraea was derived from the word astēr

facts.fact: Lax Festival 在她所住的 Aisl Park 区举办。
facts.anchor: This weekend it was being hosted in my home borough, Aisl Park

facts.fact: 野外的 Peculiars 以人的情绪能量为食，多数人看不见。
她在 Samuele 的店买 biolight 肥料，自陈专长是成像不是照明。
facts.anchor: My expertise is imaging, not lighting
There was no gold in the Treasury

facts.fact: 弟弟 Maxim 是 Treasury 的 First Keeper，她要他推动专利申请。
Maxim 警告：把信徒眼中的神圣说成寻常会招致抵触。

facts.fact: 父亲病了，Maxim 说她父亲又点名要见她。
